title: Anniversary Celebration
wikitext:
{{Quotation|[[Login screen announcements]]|The party is on for the anniversary of [[Guild Wars]]! Starting April 15th at Noon Pacific (-7 GMT), we open [[Shing Jea Boardwalk]], [[Dragon Arena]], and the [[Rollerbeetle Racing|Rollerbeetle Races]]. In addition, [[Birthday Cupcake]]s and many other special items will [[drop]] all throughout this event. For more information, visit http://www.guildwars.com/.}} {{Quotation|[https://www.guildwars.com/en/events Official website]|Guild Wars is another year older and the party just won't stop! Strap on your party hats, unpack your fireworks, and get ready to celebrate!}} The [[Anniversary Celebration]] is a [[special event]] that occurs annually from April 22, 19:00 UTC, ([https://wiki.guildwars.com/index.php?title=Template_talk%3ASpecial_events_lookup&action=historysubmit&diff=2559921&oldid=2559054 source]) to May 6, 19:00 UTC, ([[Feedback:Game updates/20150420|source 1]], [[Feedback:Game updates/20150422#Conclusion|2]]) which commemorates the original release of Guild Wars on April 28, 2005. The 20th anniversary celebration started a week early, on April 15, 2025, and ran until May 6 as usual ([[Feedback:Game updates/20250402|source]]). == Festivities == ;PvE * The [[Shing Jea Boardwalk]] is open. * Complete [[cooperative mission]]s to receive [[Proof of Legend|Proofs of Legend]]. * [[Ceira, Sworn to Fire]] offers to [[unlock]] the [[Hound of Balthazar]]. * A fifteen-minute [[firework]]s display occurs at the beginning of every hour (UTC) in [[Great Temple of Balthazar]], [[Lion's Arch]], [[Shing Jea Monastery]] and [[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan]]. * [[Kaineng Center]] and Shing Jea Monastery are decorated. ;PvP * The [[Dragon Arena]], and [[Rollerbeetle Racing]] are open. * The [[Pilgrimage to the Hall of Heroes]] quest can be acquired from [[Anzhaer, Hammer of Balthazar]]. == Items == === PvE === {{see|:Category:Balthazar's weapons|Decade weapon|Anniversary weapon}} {| {{STDT|+=text-align:center;}} |- style="background:#FDA;" | [[Blessing of War]] | [[Proof Collects |- |[[Ancient Anniversary Weaponsmith]]1 || [[Embark Beach]] || 5 [[Proof of Legend|Proofs of Legend]] |- | [[Anzhaer, Hammer of Balthazar]]1 || [[Heroes' Ascent (outpost)|Heroes' Ascent]] || - |- | [[Elite Xunlai Agent Isa Ku]]1 || [[Great Temple of Balthazar]], [[Lion's Arch]], [[Shing Jea Monastery]], and [[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan]] || 10 [[Victory Token]]s |- | [[Sadie Salvitas]] || Lion's Arch || {{cost|100}} |- | [[Zaishen Acolyte]]1 || Heroes' Ascent || 1 [[Proof of Steel]] |} #These NPCs continue to appear for one week after the Anniversary Celebration until May 13, 19:00 UTC. == Anniversary Updates == ;Annual Updates * All of the Anniversary Celebrations prior to the [[Eighth Year Anniversary Celebration]] (2013‎) introduced a new [[Birthday Present]]. The Eighth Year Anniversary Celebration introduced the [[Birthday Present Voucher]]. ;10th Anniversary * The [[Feedback:Game updates/20150422|April 22, 2015 update]] introduced several new features to the Anniversary Celebration. ;15th Anniversary * The [[Feedback:Game_updates/20200422|April 22, 2020 update]] added [[List of Anniversary Celebration elite skills|10 new PvE-only elite skills]], one for each profession, as well as the [[Anniversary weapon]]s. ;20th Anniversary * The [[Feedback:Game updates/20250409|April 9]] and [[Feedback:Game updates/20250415|April 15, 2025 update]] made [[List of exclusive weapon drops|some limited weapons now permanently available as rare drops]], permanently added a new series of [[suffix]] [[upgrade component|mod]]s, "[[of the (Profession)]]", and made a new set of [[Decade weapons]] acquirable from the [[Ancient Anniversary Weaponsmith]]. Additionally, a series of miniatures previously limited to special promotions and contest prizes became permanently available from new [[hard mode]] [[quest]]s obtainable at [[Embark Beach]]. == Notes == * This event is unique in that all foes can drop multiple [[#Items|event-related items]] at the same time, not just bosses. == Trivia == * The Ninth (2014) Year Anniversary Celebration started earlier than expected on April 2, 19:00 UTC ([https://wiki.guildwars.com/index.php?title=Feedback_talk:Matthew_Moore&diff=2567268#Early_anniversary_celebration source]). From April 2 until the [[Feedback:Game updates/20140417|April 17 update]], it only featured Elite Xunlai Agent Isa Ku, fireworks displays, Ceira, Sworn to Fire offering to unlock the Hound of Balthazar, and event-related drops. After the April 17 update, all [[#Festivities|Anniversary Celebration festivities]] (except Sadie Salvitas) became active. After the [[Feedback:Game updates/20140418|April 18 update]], Sadie Salvitas began appearing. The event ended as expected on April 29, 19:00 UTC. * In the Eighth (2013) and Ninth (2014) Year Anniversary Celebrations, the events were scheduled to occur annually from April 22, 19:00, to April 29, 19:00 UTC ([https://wiki.guildwars.com/index.php?title=Template_talk%3ASpecial_events_lookup&action=historysubmit&diff=2559921&oldid=2559054 source]). The [[Feedback:Game updates/20150420|April 20, 2015 update]] increased the duration of the event to two weeks (ending on May 6, 19:00) for the Tenth (2015) Year and future Anniversary Celebrations. == See also == * [[List of Anniversary Celebration elite skills|List of Anniversary skills]] * [[Gallery of Decade weapons]] * [[Gallery of Anniversary weapons]] == External links == * [https://www.guildwars.com/en/events/anniversary Anniversary Celebration on the official Guild Wars website] {{special events nav}} [[Category:Anniversary Celebration| ]] [[fr:Anniversaire de Guild Wars]]
